pages.text: Modular Storage is a searchable storage block. Insert a $(l:rftoolsbase:modularstorage/storagemodules)Storage Module$(/l) to define how many stacks it can hold.
The block stores items in the module, so the module can keep its contents when moved. Higher tier modules unlock larger inventories.
Use the GUI to search, sort, compact, and cycle through visible inventory sizes. The module slot controls the actual storage capacity.
